mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% in the most recent month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to rising discount rates and reduced liquidity over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 3 months), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 6 months reflects robust supply chain activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300.0 thousand units in the most recent month, it signals a weakening housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening monetary policy amid labor market strength, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high labor market tightness (PAYEMS growth exceeding 150,000 jobs per month for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and potential central bank intervention.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during high labor market tightness (PAYEMS growth > 150,000 for 3 months), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
